export interface CodeColouring {
    text: string;
    language: string;
    pieces: Array<[CodeTokenKind | null, string]>;
    starts: number[];
    from: number;
}

export type CodeTokenKind = "comment" | "string" | "number" | "keyword" | "type" | "function" | "property" | "operator" | "tag" | "attribute" | "inserted" | "deleted" | "meta";

export declare function codeLanguage(hint: string): string;

export declare function codeTokens(text: string, language: string, from?: number): Array<[CodeTokenKind | null, string]>;

export declare function diffRowTokens(rows: ReadonlyArray<{
    text: string;
    kind: string;
}>, language: string, tokens: (text: string, language: string) => Array<[CodeTokenKind | null, string]>): Array<Array<[CodeTokenKind | null, string]>>;

export declare function growCodeTokens(last: CodeColouring | null, text: string, language: string, tokens: (text: string, language: string, from?: number) => Array<[CodeTokenKind | null, string]>): CodeColouring;
